svg.title: OmniRoute free-tier budget: ~11.3B as others count · ~90M real
svg.desc: Free-tier budget card. ~11.3B free tokens a month counted the way other catalogs count, with every row added up and ended offers included. ~90M real today, each shared quota counted once, which is what you can actually use. Up to ~153M in your first month with one-time signup credits. ~159M summed per live row. 12 pools with a published quota and 214 catalog rows with free access, catalog audited 2026-11-23.
